crossRefs.note: and you shall detest them. You shall not eat of their meat, and you shall detest their carcasses.

translations.web: and you shall detest them. You shall not eat of their meat, and you shall detest their carcasses.
translations.bsb: They shall be an abomination to you; you must not eat their meat, and you must detest their carcasses.
translations.kjv: They shall be even an abomination unto you; ye shall not eat of their flesh, but ye shall have their carcases in abomination.
translations.asv: and they shall be an abomination unto you; ye shall not eat of their flesh, and their carcasses ye shall have in abomination.
